notes.title: Small update
notes.notes: [h3][b][i]you will need to start a new game file for the in-game Achievements[/i][/b][/h3][p][/p][p]*bug fixes [/p][p]*Added weapon upgrading to the shop (I think the pricing is ok, but maybe folks have thoughts on if anything should be cheaper/more expensive, still fine tuning sounds/etc. but it is barebones usable ATM.[/p][p]*new options menu UI, much clearer now[/p][p]*added in-game achievements to the game, you can view them in the options menu and at the start of a file load they will try to call in the Steam Achievements, hoping this will get those to load for folks who were not able to get the Achievements before. [/p][p][/p][p]The best way to test would be to burn a bush, if the Steam Achievement doesn't call, save your game then load that file. it tries to call 1 Achievement every 3 secs after a file is loaded, so I think it would check if you have the bush burning Achievement around 9-12ish secs after the file is loaded. I've tested a few times and it works on my devices at least, I have been able to get all Achievements again.[/p][p][/p][p]More updates soon[/p][p]Thanks [/p][p]-Ash [/p]

notes.title: Mega update!
notes.notes: [h3][b]Thanks everyone for playing over nextfest & leaving all the awesome feedback, just pushed a new version of the demo with a ton of stuff[/b][/h3][p][b](I strongly advise starting a new game file, loading from a old file will likely cause bugs)[/b][/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536173/59c0c3d4ca7ca4f348c4e08a711afa54c4e31082.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536173/43785a43098f36ff59e54916e3529542167b6026.png"][/img][/p][h2]NEW STUFF :[/h2][p]*Boneheads have been overhauled, and now are more aggressive when you are in their area. when at a distance you can also shoot their knees to cause them to fall down & shoot their heads for chance at an insta kill. if you do the jump/slam attack it will stun them back depending on how near you are to them when you land (good for fighting a few at a time) you can also parry​ their attacks and then kick them, this is also good for taking on a few at a time cause Ransom's kick will send them all flying back in OG RE4 style :)  [/p][p]*bone heads now have voices/yell things at you (a lot more fun I think)[/p][p]*RB is now a dodge/roll (good for quickly getting out of the way of large attacks)[/p][p]*Sprint is now triggered by double tapping directionals  [/p][p]*I made new versions of the little crawling enemies, they are more like super Metroid zoomers now[/p][p]* bullets now land where you are aiming rather then moving across the screen so you can be more accurate with shots [/p][p]*re designed most of the buildings, and added a new puzzles to the Plasmadine office, some of the other puzzles have been moved into later parts of the game and will be made better :) [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536173/b76b10f0da7eb152c3d24860f8a731a60103aef9.png"][/img][/p][p]*A and B are now always confirm and cancel/back across all menus (or SHOULD be, let me know if I missed this anywhere)[/p][p]*X is now the action/interact button[/p][p]*Attack & shoot are now both RT, you will shoot if aiming and do melee attack if not aiming (similar to RE games)[/p][p]*blocking is now just one button,  LT [/p][p]*if you stand at chain locks you can now use bolt cutters on them from the pause menu without needing to equip them[/p][p]*new camera system added to almost all areas and more zoomed out in most locations[/p][p]*lore stones now all look the same in all locations.[/p][p]*added another little shack before bloody mouth + made the first shack larger more interesting [/p][p]*in the town area you are now forced to go around some destroyed trucks/cars, this is to force players into the back alley, as some players missed that path. I also extended the back alley and made it more visually interesting as well as the areas past the tunnel[/p][p]*you now can't take damage for 1/2 second after blocking an enemy attack. This was added to account for taking on 3-4 enemies at once [/p][p]*moving items between crate and inventory is now switched to A to help it hopefully feel more intuitive [/p][p]*you can no longer trigger the reload animation when you don't have bullets or if the gun is fully loaded[/p][p]*base zoom level is now more zoomed out, and when large bosses are active the camera pulls back even more.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536173/62bd5dbaf19f7d4db987f0a0076075cc3e2a496c.png"][/img][/p][p]*added new SFX to blood raven enemies[/p][p]*item crate made to stand out more from the environment and are in more places[/p][p]*fixed laser sight to track with gun when jumping  [/p][p]*entering and exiting buildings and rooms is much faster now[/p][p]*going between rooms now has door SFX [/p][p]*bloody mouth battle fully done over, new attack patterns and much less jank now[/p][p]*files and notes have been totally done over, shortened a lot of the text and you can now view the front and back of files to discover secrets.[/p][p]*updated the map to be larger and look nicer[/p][p]*new key pad puzzles are now scattered throughout the game, you can find the passwords on files you find. (each time you start a new game the codes are randomized so you will always need to locate the files to get the correct password)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536173/94573bdb169706a5a3064a1bd35d433a687c1cf5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536173/9e7009587770de86bd327e0ee3e452951a367eba.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]still fine tuning some stuff, so the demo will go a bit further into the game once I have it all ready/ in the next update. [/p][p]hope you'll try it out, and thanks all for the great feedback, most of the changes made were thanks to folks giving great suggestions. and as always please remember to wishlist and follow + tell everyone you know to do the same! lol [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks [/p][p]More soon [/p][p]-Ash [/p]

notes.title: new update with bug fixes & improvements
notes.notes:
Hi All, 
[previewyoutube=UFabwbzv3Lw;full][/previewyoutube]

I have been getting tons of great feedback from folks in the community, thanks so much everyone for playing and giving input, it has been super helpful and feels nice to have people other than myself assessing the game. here is a list of some of the things I've added to the latest update

[h3]NEW STUFF [/h3]

*New boss music added
*jump now has more weight to it.
*adjust jump attack so it doesn't go as high, so hopefully people can't cheat past the breaker puzzle.
*if you are aiming you won't interact with objects if you press the action button.
*you can now switch movement to D-pad, when on you can also use D-pad in the pause/options menu. 
*you can toggle tabs in the pause menu with shoulder buttons.
*options screen now has "return to main menu" option
*adjusted the climb up animation some and also adjusted the camera movement when pulling up so hopefully it looks slightly less janky, I will continue to fine tune it :) 
*Gas station and Plasmadine office/loading dock area cameras improved, I am building out how the room cameras will work within Vongarland Castle and I am using those cam systems in those spots now.
*holding down/up in costume select menu will now scroll quickly
*fixed bug that was causing fence to lock on wrong side at the final boss battle (fixed it for real this time)
*added a better SFX for jumping into water 

getting some help from the super talented [b]jake harding[/b] he is lent his voice skills to help with new audio for the ship Captain and with the Richard Bentley cut scene (it sounds much better than what I had there, sorry for all those who had to hear my version lol) should have some need voice work for Bloody Mouth very soon as well.

added welcome/goodbye SFX to the captain when you go to the shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536173/44b2bc064f2544b21c46d58af1801fa7c8423ee3.jpg[/img]

****************DEMO SPOILERS**********
I have built out the skill tree, in later chapters after Ransom is infected she will be able to trigger Vampire Powers, there are 4 main skills you will unlock, but you can also upgrade them further via the skill tree, things like walking through water at full speed, using waypoints, etc. these will all be optional powers you can unlock 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536173/28206904747cfc321492050d15e190ee488fafe9.png[/img]

Thanks again everyone. and if you haven't already don't forget to tell everyone you know to wishlist the game lol -Ash

notes.title: Auto Sprint added + more changes
notes.notes:
hi all, more bug fixes and changes, trying to get the demo tightened up, if you find anything you think needs changing or adjusting please feel free to post in the comments


[h2]NEW STUFF [/h2]

*when you aim at explosive barrels the now show their blast range so you can stand at a safe distance

*you can now toggle auto sprint from the options menu, if on then Ransom will start sprinting automatically if you keep moving 

*Crank is now found in the Plasmadine office, you can no longer access the lighthouse in the first chapter/demo, I did this to tighten up both the main game and demo, and make the pacing better (hopefully). 
lighthouse + boss will now be in a later chapter and I am making the lighthouse much bigger/more complex

*you can now activated what will be the waypoints / fast travel in the main game, you can't actually use them until later in the game tho, so you can just turn them on right now

*it is now possible (in the demo) to find the fabric store key and unlock the costume that is a obvious nod to RE2 Claire
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536173/ccfaa0b961f39555602d7a3ea1e037b662e121f2.png[/img]

*gas station boss now shows HP triggers boss music

*if you pause while Steve is talking to you the dialogue will pause

*made the office puzzle cabinet a bit easier, when you press left or right it spins in set amounts now, I think it was not forgiving enough the way I had it before.

*little bug fixes

*new musics added, the game has a base track and when you enter some areas or get near enemies other layers of the music trigger in on top of the base layer


Thanks as always 
Please wishlist & follow
-Ash

notes.title: Another Demo Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536173/cd24d4c9ef197b42e7c741cf52477a70735ce6d0.jpg[/img]
[b]Got some new stuff into the main game / demo [/b]

* new music has been added, the basic level track is new and when you enter a puzzle screen there is a new track. more new music tracks for enemies/safe areas/bosses are coming soon.
* customize your control layout!  ABXY LB LT RB BT buttons can now be mapped (button mapping is in the options menu on the title screen or by pressing select when in game)
*when you get larger guns like the shotgun or machine gun they can be seen on Ransom's back in game.
* map regions can be found in the game, and when viewing the map from the pause screen areas now have names and you can zoom in and out on the map with LB RB. 
*general bug fixes typo fixes
*files full text should show on all screens now
*files names should show in pause menu now

and as mentioned in the last post 

*Added drowning & air supply - now when you are under water you have an air meter and if it runs out you die.
*the Captain now is out on the ship deck when the game starts and will talk if you get near him.
I saw/heard from some players that they were missing that you could enter the ship so hopefully this will fix anyone missing that at the game start.


[b]if loading a old save file all buttons might do the same thing, I THINK i made a failsafe that won't let this happen, but if it does it is because of the new controller mapping, you'll just need to go into the options screen a map them.[/b]

Thanks as always! 
and if you haven't already, please consider wish listing and following! 
-Ash

notes.title: Demo update bug fixes localization and more!
notes.notes:
[h1]A new demo update is now live [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536173/b49d562aeefa4a06a42ad65e7b765f30e31b0dcc.jpg[/img]

[h3]You should start a new file with this version, loading an old file may causes some issues, I am not 100% sure. so I would just start with a new save file.[/h3]



[h1]Things added after getting feedback :[/h1]

[h3]*added an  extra crate in the lighthouse.
*when you get a new jacket there is now a "NEW JACKET" alert in the pause menu to remind you to check it out
*added extra save point to the office.
*added some pop up guides on how to block, sprint, slide and do different attacks.
*you can now block some of Bloody Mouth's attacks.
*the map now works (kinda) I will be adding more to the map soon + pick ups the give you maps for other regions
*the chapter end now gives your play time, I am working on a ranking system, so you will actually get a rank at the end of the chapter soon
*Language support for German, Japanese, Russian, Chinese & Portuguese [/h3]

[b]Reminder I am a solo dev so I was only able to localize using google translate, there are undoubtedly issues with some of the translations, if you speak one of the above languages and find issues please post in the community and I will get them corrected[/b]


[h2]Big bug fixes[/h2]
*moving weapons from inventory into crate or dropping them should now un-equip them.
*Lighthouse boss should always trigger now.
*glitch with ransoms body moving off her legs shouldn't happen anymore
*lots of other little fixes


Thanks again for playing and giving feedback everyone! 
I'll have more news about the next chapter soon 
-Ash
